questions_and_answers.question_text: What is the literal meaning of bù qiǎo?
How is méi bànfǎ used within a sentence?
What does méi bànfǎ mean when used independently?
Write the Chinese for "We really couldn't make that."
Write the Chinese for "We have no way of going."

answers.answer_text: "To get together" — a reduplicated form of jù, "to assemble."

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "I hope that later we will find another opportunity to get together."

answers.answer_text: Xīwàng yǐhòu zài zhǎo jīhui jùyijù ba.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Which adverb means "again" in Xīwàng yǐhòu zài zhǎo jīhui?

articles.text:
6. B: Zhēn bù qiǎo.                   We really couldn't make that.
   B: Nèitian wǒmen yǒu shì, méi     We have a previous engagement that
      bànfǎ qù.                       day; we have no way of going.

7. A: Xīwàng yǐhòu zài zhǎo jīhui    I hope that later we will find
      jùyijù ba.                      another opportunity to get together.
   B: Hǎo a.                          Okay.

Notes on No. 6

Bù qiǎo literally means "inopportune," "not timely."

Méi bànfǎ: Bànfǎ means "method," "way." Within a sentence, méi bànfǎ is used as "there is no way to...," "there is no way that...." Used independently, méi bànfǎ means "nothing can be done," "it can't be helped," "there is no way out."
